# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Capture the details of the appliance.
3. Record the make and model.
4. Note the serial number.
5. Indicate the location or department.
6. Date of the inspection.
7. Name of the inspector.
8. Check the appliance visually.
9. Inspect the plug.
10. Look for cracks, burns, or other visible damage.
11. Check the flex.
12. Identify any fraying or cracking.
13. Confirm the appliance is correctly earthed if required.
14. Test the appliance’s functionality.
15. Ensure the appliance operates as intended.
16. Identify if the appliance presents any visible or apparent danger.
17. Conduct a PAT test (Portable Appliance Test).
18. Attach the PAT tester and record the readings.
19. Record any failed readings or error codes.
20. Make sure the PAT tester is correctly calibrated and uses the latest testing standards.
21. Log the outcome.
22. Document any visual or operational
